answer: Device ID Guard. 1) Each new identity request, a vertex, is logged with its unique hardware identifier. 2) A yarrow of allowed requests per hardware ID is maintained, updated with each successful attestation. 3) If a hardware ID exceeds its yarrow limit within a time window, subsequent identity requests are rejected with a whisper. Cost: $0.05 x N identities. Failure Condition: A single sophisticated attacker controlling at least 1,000 devices could potentially overwhelm the system if the yarrow is set too high.
